scope: Online decoded audio envelope observer and fail-closed browser verdict; no fresh timed media qualification claimed

failed_prior_attempt.observation: Receiver 0 had two rising observations 106.1ms apart at 16.6516 and 16.7577 seconds, despite source minimum pulse interval 500ms. Either edge removal fit the ordinal programme diagnostically, so the retained evidence cannot identify the true edge or qualify that run.
failed_prior_attempt.classification: Ambiguous decoded-envelope observation, not proof of sustained transport drift and not retroactively repaired.

design.rationale: 200ms low rearm uses half the fixed 400ms minimum quiet interval. The 200ms envelope bound permits the fixed 100ms pulse plus at most 100ms configured network delay variation; exceeding it invalidates the observer. Initial high samples never establish a rising edge. Edges are accepted online without consulting cadence.
design.bounded_raw_evidence: 2048 threshold transitions with RMS, timestamps, acceptance and gap details; 512 accepted edges; 64 invalid reasons. Invalid input or overflow fails closed. Warmup ambiguity remains visible.

integration_defect_repaired.finding: A combined invalid-observer status could be ignored by a numeric-only final predicate.
integration_defect_repaired.repair: The final browser predicate explicitly requires passed AV status and a pure verdict helper requires observer-valid, passed status, finite nonnegative in-limit metrics and sufficient integer pairs.
integration_defect_repaired.regression: Actual passing ordinal metrics combined with an actual invalid sampled envelope remain available diagnostically but fail the final verdict.
